dedupe_keys.name: assessing the roles of anthropogenic drainage structures on hydrologic connectivity using high resolution digital elevation models datasets

description: Assessing the roles of anthropogenic drainage structures on hydrologic connectivity using high-resolution digital elevation models (DATASETS) is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Bhadra, Sourav (deposited on HydroShare). Stream flowline delineation from high-resolution digital elevation models (HRDEMs) can be biased partly due to the as absence of information on the locations of anthropogenic drainage structures (ADS) such as bridges and culverts on the grid surface. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2021-01-23 and last updated 2021-02-05; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
